description: Department of Local Government - Southern Province - Cancellation of the W. P. R. Dilshan the Chairman of Tangalle Urban Council, Published in the Extra Gazette No. 2208/20 dated 30.12.2020
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the cancellation of an order related to a local government official (Chairman of Tangalle Urban Council) by the Provincial Governor. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it involves the exercise of legal authority and administrative powers over local government officials, specifically pertaining to the governance and oversight of urban councils under provincial administration.
